# EL-HUB VENTURES
> Web and mobile app development, technical SEO, and digital strategy for founders and growth teams in Nigeria, North America, the UK, and globally.

EL-HUB VENTURES is a digital engineering and growth partner helping operators ship scalable web apps, mobile products, cloud infrastructure, and measurable SEO programs.

## Key Pages
- / — Homepage: services, selected work, process, and latest insights
- /services — Full services catalog (web, mobile, UI/UX, cloud, SEO, AI, e-commerce, training)
- /services/web-development — Custom web development and web applications
- /services/mobile-app-development — iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile apps
- /services/seo-services — Technical SEO, on-page SEO, GEO, and growth retainers
- /case-studies — Delivery examples (labelled; not client testimonials)
- /about — Team, hubs, process, engagement models, and FAQ
- /resources — Insights hub (technical articles and guides)
- /resources/glossary — Term definitions for product, cloud, and SEO
- /resources/faq — Compiled FAQ hub with FAQPage schema
- /resources/react-vs-flutter — React Native vs Flutter for MVPs
- /resources/statistics — How to read ITU, World Bank, and NBS ICT figures
- /resources/agency-vs-freelancer — When to hire a firm vs a freelancer
- /contact — Offices (Nigeria HQ, Canada, UK, Cameroon), phone, email, and project inquiry form

## Primary Topics
- Web development (React, Next.js, Node.js)
- Mobile app development (Flutter, React Native, native)
- UI/UX design and design systems
- Technical SEO and generative-engine-friendly content structure
- Cloud architecture and DevOps (AWS, CI/CD, containers)
- Digital transformation and product strategy
- E-commerce and multi-tenant SaaS
- AI and data-driven product features
